items.text: Costs: 5 bps commission + 5 bps slippage per side (20 bps round trip). No taxes, no market impact, fills assumed at the quoted open or close.
Trades overlap in time and cluster in a few names and members, so the sample is smaller than the trade count suggests. The t-statistic treats trades as independent and overstates confidence.

Survivorship: prices come from Yahoo Finance for symbols that still trade. Delisted, acquired, and renamed symbols have no history and are excluded and counted above, which tends to flatter results. Joined tickers only (data/tickers.json); no symbol is matched by guess.
The portfolio rebalances to equal weight (or size weight) each day across open positions. Per-trade returns are buy-and-hold and do not include this rebalancing.
Only 0 trades. Treat the result as an anecdote, not evidence.
Form 4 history: 216 of 240 filings read for 4 join-table issuers, filed 2025-02-28 to 2026-09-25. Each issuer's newest 60 Form 4s in the window are read.
24 Form 4 filings were still being read from SEC EDGAR when the time budget ended and are not in this run. They keep loading; run again in a minute.
4 issuers filed more than 60 Form 4s in the window (GD, LMT, NOC, RTX); only their newest 60 are read, so their earlier insider trades are missing.
69 lines flagged as 10b5-1 plan trades and 230 non-open-market lines (grants, tax withholding, exercises) are excluded.
